# Pull Request: Add New Personas to Project Management Processes

## Description
This pull request implements issue #3 by expanding the `docs/octoacme-roles-and-personas.md` document with five new personas that enhance clarity and accountability in the OctoAcme project management framework.

## Changes
- **QA/Testing Lead**: Owns quality assurance strategy, test planning, and acceptance validation
- **Technical Architect/Lead**: Owns technical design, system integration, and technical feasibility analysis
- **Stakeholder/Sponsor**: Represents business interests and provides approval authority
- **Scrum Master/Agile Coach**: Facilitates agile ceremonies, removes impediments, and coaches on agile practices
- **Security Lead**: Ensures security requirements and compliance are integrated throughout the project lifecycle

Each new persona includes role summary, responsibilities, goals, interaction patterns with existing roles, and typical communication cadence.

## Why This Matters
The current personas document covered only three core roles (Developers, Product Managers, Project Managers), but many OctoAcme projects involve additional stakeholders and specialists. These additions:

- Provide comprehensive coverage of all typical roles in project execution
- Clarify accountability and decision-making authority across all phases
- Help new team members understand cross-functional dependencies
- Establish clear communication patterns for each role
- Support better onboarding and project staffing decisions
- Align with the principle of clear ownership mentioned in the Project Management Overview
